pm.set.help.title: --- Instance Set Commands ---
pm.set.help.history: /pm <id> set history <lines> - Set output history limit
pm.set.help.maxarchives: /pm <id> set maxarchives <count> - Set max number of compressed archives
pm.set.help.exitcode: /pm <id> set exitcode <code> - Set exit code (requires restart)
pm.set.help.srs: /pm <id> set statusrefreshseconds <sec> - Set status refresh interval
pm.set.help.processmonitor: /pm <id> set processmonitor enable/disable - Toggle process monitoring
pm.set.help.networkmonitor: /pm <id> set networkmonitor enable/disable - Toggle network monitoring
pm.set.help.compressionformat: /pm <id> set compressionformat tar.gz/zip - Set compression format
pm.set.help.compressionstrategy: /pm <id> set compressionstrategy OLD/ASYNC/IDLE/SCHEDULED - Set compression strategy
pm.set.help.scm: /pm <id> set scheduledcompressionminutes <minutes> - Set scheduled compression interval
pm.set.help.savelogtime: /pm <id> set savelogtime enable/disable - Toggle timestamp in logs
pm.set.help.timeformat: /pm <id> set timeformat <format> - Set timestamp format (e.g. HH:mm:ss)
pm.set.help.outputalone: /pm <id> set outputalone enable/disable - Toggle output bypassing Minecraft logging
pm.set.help.outputwithtime: /pm <id> set outputwithtime enable/disable - Toggle timestamps when outputAlone is enabled
pm.set.help.outputtimeformat: /pm <id> set outputtimeformat <format> - Set timestamp format (e.g. HH:mm:ss) for outputAlone
pm.set.help.note: Note: Some settings require a restart.
